detectors.description:
Reentrancy in Ledger.multiMint(uint256,uint256[]) ():
	External calls:
	- controller.ledgerTransfer(0,a,value) ()
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balanceOf[a] = balanceOf[a] + value ()
	Ledger.balanceOf () can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- Ledger.burn(address,uint256) ()
	- Ledger.multiMint(uint256,uint256[]) ()
	- Ledger.transfer(address,address,uint256) ()
	- Ledger.transferFrom(address,address,address,uint256) ()
detectors.markdown:
Reentrancy in [Ledger.multiMint(uint256,uint256[])]():
	External calls:
	- [controller.ledgerTransfer(0,a,value)]()
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- [balanceOf[a] = balanceOf[a] + value]()
	[Ledger.balanceOf]() can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- [Ledger.burn(address,uint256)]()
	- [Ledger.multiMint(uint256,uint256[])]()
	- [Ledger.transfer(address,address,uint256)]()
	- [Ledger.transferFrom(address,address,address,uint256)]()
